articles.summary: A PEO gives a small business access to big-company benefits, HR expertise, and compliance support through a co-employment model. This guide explains how a PEO works, what it costs, what it does and doesn't support, and how to choose one. You'll leave able to judge whether a PEO fits your business.
articles.title: PEO for Small Business: Benefits, Costs, and How to Choose One

articles.summary: Clear employee benefits communication helps employees understand, choose, and use the benefits a company already pays for. TriNet’s 2027 State of the Workplace report found that 80% of employers believe employees understand their benefits while 65% of employees say they do, and this article shows where that gap appears and the steps that help close it. You’ll come away with a year-round communication plan and a short survey for checking what employees understand.
articles.title: Employee Benefits Communication: How to Close the Understanding Gap
